title: black and white photo props
text:
black and white photo props. Geez. The photo of these shows GLITTER - or the appearance of GLITTER. But if you don't carefully read the WAY too long description which says NO GLITTER - you'll be disappointed. It is nice they are already assembled - so they get 3 stars... but they get ZERO stars for their misleading photos of the props.. Not only is there NO sparkle of any kind.. they are literally just black and white. So.. I briefly considered applying some glitter glue... but then... they landed in the garbage can.. Not worth the effort to return. Just flat out disappointed in the seller's photos of the props to sell them. Because if you were to see what they look like in person, you wouldn't buy them!! Stinks. Meh.
UPDATE: 1/7/2019 Because I do my best to be fair and honest... I received an email from the seller.. they are trying a glitter cover to the photo area that appears to be glitter already. They included a photo of what they are trying.. for me... it appears to be a thin cover of tiny glitter flakes over the area that looks like it has glitter.. and because the props are literally black and white - I think the cover appears a bit yellowish... for me, I wanted the big chunky glitter so I wouldn't really have worked for me.. but that is just my personal opinion. They also generously provided me a refund. I did improve my rating by one star because the seller is really trying to make this product better in my opinion.
